```plato
    // One dual vertex per face, one dual face per vertex.
    Dual(self: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMeshOfFaces(
            self.PolarVertices,
            self.VertexCount.MapRange(v => self.DualFaceOfVertex(VertexIndex(v))));
```

```plato

    //==
    // # Polyhedral dual pairings on the solid kinds
    //
    // The known dual-polyhedron partner of each named solid kind, as total maps on
    // the kind sums in `solids.types.plato`
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dual_polyhedron). This is the identity-level
    // counterpart of the geometric Conway `Dual` on `PolygonMesh3D`
    //: that operation constructs the dual mesh of
    // any mesh; these maps record which named form the dual of a named form is, so
    // the Archimedean/Catalan pairing is vocabulary rather than a catalog comment.
    // Dual is an involution: `kind.Dual.Dual == kind` for every kind below.

    // The dual Platonic solid: cube and octahedron swap, dodecahedron and
    // icosahedron swap, and the tetrahedron is self-dual
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Platonic_solid).
    Dual(self: PlatonicSolid): PlatonicSolid
        => match (self) {
            Tetrahedron => PlatonicSolid.Tetrahedron;
            Cube => PlatonicSolid.Octahedron;
            Octahedron => PlatonicSolid.Cube;
            Dodecahedron => PlatonicSolid.Icosahedron;
            Icosahedron => PlatonicSolid.Dodecahedron;
        };
```

```plato
    // The Catalan dual of each Archimedean solid
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catalan_solid).
    Dual(self: ArchimedeanSolid): CatalanSolid
        => match (self) {
            TruncatedTetrahedron => CatalanSolid.TriakisTetrahedron;
            Cuboctahedron => CatalanSolid.RhombicDodecahedron;
            TruncatedCube => CatalanSolid.TriakisOctahedron;
            TruncatedOctahedron => CatalanSolid.TetrakisHexahedron;
            Rhombicuboctahedron => CatalanSolid.DeltoidalIcositetrahedron;
            TruncatedCuboctahedron => CatalanSolid.DisdyakisDodecahedron;
            SnubCube => CatalanSolid.PentagonalIcositetrahedron;
            Icosidodecahedron => CatalanSolid.RhombicTriacontahedron;
            TruncatedDodecahedron => CatalanSolid.TriakisIcosahedron;
```

```plato
    // The Archimedean dual of each Catalan solid: the inverse of the map above

    Dual(self: CatalanSolid): ArchimedeanSolid

            TriakisTetrahedron => ArchimedeanSolid.TruncatedTetrahedron;
            RhombicDodecahedron => ArchimedeanSolid.Cuboctahedron;
```
